summary: Iteration 30 (main-agent-labelled iter 19) testing. Backend: 5/5 pytest pass — /api/trust/timeseries returns exactly 30 daily buckets with correct schema, /api/trust/stats regression (all 6 counters intact), GET /api/integrations/crm as employer returns items[], talent role also 200, and POST /api/integrations/crm/connect with hubspot+garbage token correctly returns 400. Frontend: all 12 requested UI checks pass. /trust renders trust-page + trust-charts with 4 Recharts area charts (chart-refs, chart-engagements, chart-verified-talents, chart-verified-companies) each with a visible SVG path. /register renders turnstile-widget and shows Cloudflare test-key 'Success!' badge; submit button becomes enabled. /integrations as employer shows crm-section with 4 provider tiles; clicking hubspot reveals crm-connect-form + crm-token-input; salesforce also reveals crm-instance-input. /employer/shortlist correctly HIDES crm-push-* buttons when no CRM is connected (0 buttons rendered — hide branch works). /projects unauthenticated modal shows pricing-signin-nudge and NO price-transparency + NO 'Job Atlas margin'/'Team cost' text. /projects authenticated modal shows price-transparency with breakdown (Seats/Hrs/Monthly/Total) and still NO 'Job Atlas margin'/'Team cost' text. /projects/{id}/workspace as admin shows only budget/billed/paid/hours-var/cost-var tiles — no rollup-margin, no admin-team-cost, no 'Job Atlas margin'/'Team cost' strings anywhere. Global color audit: gold #C79A3B, #F0C260 and bright red #FF0A0A are ABSENT from /trust, /register, /projects, /employer/shortlist, and /projects/{id}/workspace HTML; violet #6B21A8 accents visible on Trust chart lines and overlines.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py public_trust_timeseries: correctly pre-fills 30 buckets keyed by yyyy-mm-dd so days with zero activity still return integers 0 for refs/engagements/verified_*. Uses verified_at with created_at fallback so historical seeded verified users still appear on today's bucket — matches the note in review_request other_misc_info.

Trust.jsx: 4 Recharts <AreaChart> cards render inside data-testid=trust-charts, colored with VIOLET=#6B21A8 stroke+gradient — palette compliant. Total numbers on each card sum from the same series[] so cards agree with the SVG.

Register.jsx Turnstile: uses window.turnstile.render with sitekey fallback to Cloudflare's public test key 1x00000000000000000000AA (auto-passes). data-testid=turnstile-widget renders immediately; success badge unblocks submit; the fallback timer wires data-testid=turnstile-fallback only if the script fails to load within 6s (not exercised in tests because the CF CDN is reachable).

Integrations.jsx: crm-section correctly gated behind user.role==='employer' (talent role never renders the section — confirmed by GET /integrations/crm as talent still returning 200 empty). Provider tiles hubspot/salesforce/slack/sharepoint all present with data-testid; connect form only shows crm-instance-input when provider==='salesforce' — matches spec.

Shortlist.jsx: 'Push to CRM' button correctly HIDDEN when crmConns.length===0. Verified live — 3 shortlist cards rendered, 0 crm-push-* buttons. The button will surface once a real CRM token is stored.

Projects.jsx pricing gate: unauth branch shows 'Estimate / Sign in for quote' + pricing-signin-nudge, no price-transparency, no 'Job Atlas margin' anywhere. Authed branch shows $124.3k 'You pay / mo' + data-testid=price-transparency with a 4-cell Seats/Hrs-per-seat/Monthly/Total breakdown — no 'Team cost' or 'Job Atlas margin' words. Clean.

ProjectWorkspace.jsx admin rollup grid: rollup-margin and admin-team-cost tiles have been fully removed. Only Budget / Billed / Paid / Hours-var / Cost-var tiles render for admin — verified live on TEST_Iter24 FinCo project.

index.css / global color sweep: no #C79A3B, #F0C260, #FF0A0A hex substrings present in the HTML of Landing/Trust/Register/Projects/Integrations/Workspace. Violet accent (#6B21A8) confirmed visible on Trust chart lines, overlines, primary CTA buttons on shortlist card ('Purchase hours' pill), and stat-card badges.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are read-only against existing seed. CRM connect test uses a garbage hubspot token that is rejected by hubspot's own /oauth/v1/access-tokens endpoint → normalized to HTTP 400, so no CRM integration document is persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter30 pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration30_trust_crm.py runs in <2s. Note: /app/backend/pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is NOT injected into backend python env — always resolve BASE_URL by reading /app/frontend/.env directly (the _load_backend_url helper in this file does that). Login must go through the public https URL, not localhost, because auth cookies are Secure-flagged and won't be sent over http. All 12 iteration-30 acceptance checks passed on first run; no regressions to the 8 iteration-29 checks were observed.
